description:
## [2.3.0](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/releases/tag/v2.3.0) (pre-release re-cut)

- **Instagram (`com.instagram.android` `439.0.0.37.89`)**: Added 23 patches (distraction-free feed/Reels/stories/explore/notes/ads/buttons filters, MobileConfig & Tigon URL hooks, `Bypass signature check`, `Remove build expired popup`, `Clone`, `Proteus settings`, `Ghost mode`, and experimental `Change like animation`) with 15 extension helpers. The settings dialog adds action-bar buttons, chronological-feed and Ghost Mode switches, Reels speed/seek toggles, a like-animation picker, and in-app WebView tools for logged-out public browsing, profile Reels and own liked posts.
- **Instagram fix — `Change like animation`**: The experimental like-animation patch no longer fails to apply with `PatchException: No free registers available`. The `XDTUserActivationMetadataImpl.<init>` constructor is register saturated on this build, so the patch now requests a single 4-bit scratch register and carries the `Boolean` flag in the `p2` parameter register (matching upstream piko) instead of asking for two free registers. The selected animation is written back with `move-object/from16`, and the original animation is preserved when no animation is selected.
- **Meesho (#32)**: Updated target package to `com.meesho.supply` (`29.5`–`29.9`) and cleaned up `docs/MEESHO.md`.
- **Amazon (#21 / PR #31)**: Added Amazon Business (`com.amazon.mShop.android.business.shopping`) + Shopping `32.19.0.100`, `Disable screenshot detection`, expanded WebView AdBlock selectors (`amznkiller`), and WebView JS video autoplay blocking.
- **Mereframe (#5 / PR #33)**: Added BTI/PAC-safe ARM64 `.so` integrity + Pro gates (`libunnamed_raw.so`) alongside `LQu.k/m` and `Bf1c089.*` DEX hooks.
